name: Distributed Computing & Apache Spark
description: Large-scale distributed data processing using Apache Spark (PySpark & Scala), Catalyst optimizer, Tungsten execution engine, partitioning, shuffling, caching, and memory tuning.

subskills.name: Spark Cluster Architecture & Resource Managers
subskills.description: Driver, Executor, Master/Worker nodes, Task, Stage, Job breakdown, and cluster managers (Kubernetes, YARN, Standalone).

subskills.name: RDDs vs DataFrames vs Datasets APIs
subskills.description: Understanding Low-level RDD transformations/actions vs high-level DataFrame and typed Dataset APIs, immutability, and lazy evaluation.

subskills.name: Spark SQL & Catalyst Optimizer
subskills.description: Analysis, Logical Optimization, Physical Planning, Code Generation (Tungsten), Whole-Stage CodeGen, and cost-based optimization (CBO).

subskills.name: Partition Management: Coalesce, Repartition & Bucketing
subskills.description: Controlling parallelism with repartition vs coalesce, partition sizes, bucketing on high-cardinality keys, and avoiding narrow/wide shuffle hazards.

subskills.name: Shuffle Operations & Data Skew Mitigation
subskills.description: Understanding Shuffle Read/Write, Wide transformations, salting skewed keys, Adaptive Query Execution skew join handling, and isolate bad keys.

subskills.name: Broadcast Joins, Broadcast Variables & Accumulators
subskills.description: BroadcastHashJoin optimization (spark.sql.autoBroadcastJoinThreshold), distributing read-only lookups, and distributed accumulators.

subskills.name: Caching, Checkpointing & Storage Levels
subskills.description: cache() vs persist(), StorageLevel (MEMORY_ONLY, MEMORY_AND_DISK, SER), unpersisting, and breaking lineage with local/reliable checkpointing.

subskills.name: Spark Memory Tuning & OOM Troubleshooting
subskills.description: Executor memory breakdown (Storage vs Execution memory, Reserved memory, User memory), Off-Heap memory, JVM garbage collection (G1GC), and diagnosing OutOfMemory (OOM) errors.

subskills.name: Spark Structured Streaming Engine
subskills.description: Micro-batch processing, Continuous processing, streaming DataFrames, trigger policies, watermarking, stateful streaming, and streaming sinks.

subskills.name: PySpark Vectorized UDFs & PyArrow / Pandas API
subskills.description: Python UDF overhead, PySpark Pandas UDFs (@pandas_udf) with Apache Arrow serialization, and pyspark.pandas (formerly Koalas).

cv.signal: Engineered terabyte-scale distributed data pipelines using PySpark on Kubernetes

linkedin.signal: Apache Spark certified developer or Databricks Data Engineer Associate/Professional

assessment.signal: Passes Apache Spark Distributed Computing & Performance Optimization Assessment

junior.description: Writes PySpark/Spark SQL queries, operates with DataFrames, and understands cluster master/worker anatomy.

mid.description: Optimizes joins with broadcasting, writes vectorized Arrow/Pandas UDFs, manages persistence storage levels, and tunes partition counts.

senior.description: Eliminates heavy shuffle data skews with salting/AQE, diagnoses executor OOM memory dumps, and designs stateful Structured Streaming pipelines.
